description.narrative: Stöd till Albaniens EU-närmande inom miljö/kapitel 27 EU Acquis. Programmet inkluderar föreberedelser för screening och strategisk planering inför EU-förhandlingar. Miljöministeriet leder genomförandet med stöd av Naturvårdsverket som tillhandahåller egen expertis såväl som internationella och nationella experter. Miljöministeriet ansvarar för koordingering av EU-förberedelserna inom kapitel 27 och programmet avser stödja ministeriet att etablera en förhandlingsstruktur (-organisation) samt uppbyggnad av kompetens om EU-processen och den strategiska planeringen som omfattar all intressenter inom kapitel 27. Programmet omfattar stöd på ca 20 MSEK över tre år, 2017-2020. Naturvårdsverket ansvarar för genomförande och rapportering till Sida.
Support to Albania's approximation within Environment/Chapter 27. Includes preparations for Screening and strategic planning for EU-negotiations.

The overall achievement of results during the 2020 has been positive. The procedures for the Inter-Institutional Working Group 27 has been adopted and establish the structure for preparations for EU negotiations. Responsible persons and institutions for relevant EU acts under Chapter 27 have been engaged and showed dedication in taking actions for preparation of the answers to the Bilateral Screening Questionnaires (for three sub-chapters) and Action Plans. This experience has provided to MTE, as leading institution for Chapter 27 EU negotiations, a real example how the process will develop in the future and thus helped to strengthen their capacity/competence as well as their standing towards other institutions involved in Chapter 27 preparations. The preparations of IPA III programming document lead by MTE, and supported by SANE27, contributed in gaining experience in policy development and taking a comprehensive approach considering the whole Chapter 27. Beside the constrains of Covid 19, still more than 206 participants have been involved in SANE27 activities for the period of January – September 2020. Coordination and cooperation with donors continued, in particular with the EU Delegation (especially on IPA 3 programming). SANE27 has strengthened further its standing in MTE and MEFA (Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs) as well as to other partners and is generally considered to be a key support for the overall process of EU integrations for Chapter 27 in Albania. A Metaplan for Chapter 27, I e a plan which includes information on all relevant planning documents needed for EU negotiations, was prepared and will contribute to Albania's further alignment with EU environmental policy and to cover EU acquis’ requirements for planning and to support EU negotiations. MTE and other key partner institutions continue to be understaffed, which limits the overall capacity to carry out the preparations needed.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
